help.title: Help
help.intro: A short guide to Presenton. The full developer documentation is linked from every section.

start.title: Getting started
steps: Open Settings and choose a text AI provider — for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio. Enter the API key and click Save Configuration. Generation cannot start without a provider.
Optionally choose an image provider there too (Pexels and Pixabay stock photos or image generation) and a web search provider.
On the Dashboard click Create new Presentation and describe the topic. You can attach material: Word, PowerPoint, spreadsheets, PDF, TXT or images.
Set the number of slides and the presentation language, then pick a mode. Standard uses a fixed layout for predictable results. Smart uses a flexible layout that adapts to the content.
Review the outline: add, rewrite or reorder slides, or regenerate the outline. Then choose a template and start the generation.
In the editor change text, images, charts and icons right on the slide, or ask the AI assistant in the chat. Present starts the slideshow, Export saves a PPTX or PDF file.
To build a presentation by hand, choose Blank Presentation on the Dashboard.

language.title: Interface language and presentation language
items: Switch the interface language with the RU / EN / Auto buttons in the top-right corner of the screen.
Auto follows your browser: if its languages include Russian or English, the higher-ranked one is used; otherwise Russian.
The choice is saved in the browser and in your account, so it stays the same when you sign in on another device.
The presentation language is chosen separately when you create a presentation. For example, the interface can be in Russian while the slides are in English.
Sample text in new blocks, tables and charts is written in the presentation language.

templates.title: Templates and community
items: Templates contains the built-in templates and your own ones.

New Template turns your presentation into a template: upload a PPTX file (up to 100 MB), the AI analyzes the slide layouts, and you review and save the result. Accurate layouts need a model that understands images.
If the template uses custom fonts, upload their files (.ttf / .otf) so the slides look like the original.
Community shows designs made by other users: pick one and describe the presentation you want from it.

items.problem: Generation does not start or fails right away
items.solution: Check in Settings that a text provider is selected, the key is correct and the provider's quota or balance is not exhausted. The error message usually names the cause.
Reduce the number of slides, make the prompt shorter and more focused, and attach less material. Wait for uploads to finish before starting the generation.

items.problem: Slides come out incomplete or broken
items.solution: For local and custom models check the URL, model name and key: the model must support structured (JSON) output. Container logs show provider errors, timeouts and memory problems.
Give more source material, state the audience and goal, and fix the outline before generating — this matters more than switching models.
Check the format and remove password protection. Re-save old .doc, .ppt and .xls files as .docx, .pptx and .xlsx.
Use documents with a text layer or good-quality scans. Clean table markup and consistent labels help.
Check the image provider and its key in Settings — image generation may be turned off.

items.problem: A local model (Ollama, LM Studio) is unreachable
items.solution: Inside Docker, localhost points to the container itself. Use http://host.docker.internal with the model's port (11434 for Ollama) or the service name on the Docker network.

items.problem: The AI assistant edits the wrong thing
items.solution: Ask for one change at a time and name the slide to change.
Refresh the page: the presentation is saved automatically and the latest saved version opens after a refresh.

items.problem: The exported file looks different from the editor
items.solution: Before exporting, check for text overflowing its boxes and how images, charts and tables are cropped. Open the file in PowerPoint, Keynote or LibreOffice to see where the problem is.

items.problem: Fonts look different in the file
items.solution: Custom fonts must be installed on the computer that opens the file, or embedded in it.
On your own server, check that the data folder (/app_data) is writable and there is enough disk space and memory.
Make sure the container is running (docker ps), the host port is free and mapped to container port 80. The container logs (docker logs) show the cause.
Everything is stored in /app_data inside the container. A new container must mount the same host folder, otherwise it starts empty.

items.problem: The AI provider does not connect
items.solution: Check the URL, model and key, make sure the provider works outside Presenton and is reachable from the container, and that the model is installed and running.
Back up the app_data folder, pin a specific image version, and after the upgrade test providers, templates, the editor and export.

support.title: Reporting a problem
steps: Copy the exact error message and note when it happened.
Reproduce the problem with the smallest possible example.
Check whether it affects one presentation or all of them.
Remove API keys and passwords before sharing logs or configuration.
